name: Grafana smtprelay Self-Hosted SMTP Proxy
free_limit: MIT-licensed SMTP relay/proxy software for self-hosted mail forwarding, with Prometheus metrics, structured logs and OpenTelemetry tracing; no software usage quota or expiry stated.
watch_out: Grafana states this internally used project is not generally supported and may introduce breaking changes without notice. Requires a separately operated SMTP upstream, server, networking and secure credentials; email delivery or third-party SMTP fees are not included.
